description: Environment setup, green baseline, and BEFORE evidence for the mobile+accessibility workstream. Create the working branch, confirm the existing lint+build gate is green on merged main, extend the measurement harness to screenshot at two viewport widths with a horizontal-scroll assertion, and capture the current (pre-change) mobile breakage + a11y state under docs/a11y/. This is a prerequisite for FEAT-002/003 and changes NO application code.
steps: Ensure Node 22 is on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (bare `node` is not found otherwise). From /projects/sandbox/frankfabric run `npm install`.
Create and check out a NEW branch off the current main: `git checkout -b a11y/mobile-accessibility`. Do NOT push.

Confirm the baseline gate is green BEFORE any change: run `npm run lint` (expect exactly ONE pre-existing unrelated warning @next/next/no-page-custom-font in app/layout.tsx, otherwise 0) and `npm run build` (static export succeeds; all five routes prerender). Record the exact output.

Add a viewport/a11y screenshot harness. Prefer a sibling script scripts/measure-viewports.mjs that reuses measure-load.mjs's server-mount + Chrome-launch setup (serve built out/ under BASE_PATH /frankfabric, CHROME_PATH=/usr/local/bin/chrome, --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --no-sandbox). It must: accept a --route and --label, load the route at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900, wait for canvas (or load for the landing page), take a full-page screenshot at each width, and MEASURE document.documentElement.scrollWidth and window.innerWidth, asserting scrollWidth <= innerWidth (no horizontal scroll). Write a JSON report per route+width capturing {route, width, height, scrollWidth, innerWidth, noHorizontalScroll:boolean} and a PNG. Do NOT modify measure-load.mjs's existing behavior in a way that breaks prior-workstream usage; a new sibling file is preferred. This script is a measurement tool, NOT part of the build.

Run `npm run build`, then run the harness for all five routes (/, /projects/chef-chatbot/, /projects/coach-trainer/, /projects/digital-wardrobe/, /projects/virtual-pet/) at both widths, writing PNG+JSON under docs/a11y/before-*. Capture the current mobile breakage (panel possibly covering/cramping the canvas and/or any horizontal scroll) at 390x844 and the desktop view at 1280x900.

Write docs/a11y/BASELINE.md documenting: the machine/runtime (Node v22.23.2 via /opt/toolchains, Chromium via /usr/local/bin/chrome, headless, swiftshader ANGLE) and browser; the exact lint+build output; a per-route table of scrollWidth vs innerWidth at both widths (flagging any route with horizontal scroll); and the CURRENT keyboard/focus/reduced-motion/canvas-aria state observed in code — specifically: (a) which widgets already have sr-only labels/focus rings/aria-live, (b) that chef/coach/pet Canvas have role='img' + a short aria-label while the wardrobe Canvas has NEITHER, (c) that there is NO prefers-reduced-motion / matchMedia handling anywhere so camera nudges, idle/ambient particle motion, wardrobe autoRotate, and the landing-page CSS animations (animate-scan/ticker/marquee/emberPulse/ringSpin/floatY) all run unconditionally.

Commit ONLY the harness script + docs/a11y/before-* evidence + BASELINE.md (and package-lock.json if npm install changed it). Do NOT commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/. Use a message like `chore(a11y): WS4 branch + BEFORE baseline evidence and viewport harness`.
acceptance_criteria: Branch a11y/mobile-accessibility exists and is checked out, created off the merged main (contains WS1+WS2+WS3).
`npm run lint` shows only the one expected font warning; `npm run build` completes a static export with all five routes prerendered — recorded verbatim in BASELINE.md.
scripts/measure-viewports.mjs (or equivalent) exists, reuses the measure-load.mjs setup, and emits per-route/per-width PNG + JSON with a scrollWidth<=innerWidth boolean.

docs/a11y/ contains BEFORE screenshots + JSON for all five routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900, plus BASELINE.md stating machine/browser, the gate output, the per-route scroll table, and the current keyboard/focus/reduced-motion/canvas-aria state.
Nothing under node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/ is staged or committed.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint (only the font warning) && npm run build (export succeeds).
Run the new harness for all five routes at both widths against the built out/ and confirm each writes a PNG + JSON under docs/a11y/before-*.
git status confirms no build output or node_modules staged; git log shows the baseline commit on a11y/mobile-accessibility.
findings: Branch a11y/mobile-accessibility created off merged main (HEAD 8123443, WS1+WS2+WS3). npm install: already up to date, package-lock.json UNCHANGED (not committed). Gate green: `npm run lint` -> exactly one pre-existing @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx (0 errors, 0 other warnings); `npm run build` -> clean static export, all five routes prerendered (/, /projects/chef-chatbot, /projects/coach-trainer, /projects/digital-wardrobe, /projects/virtual-pet). Node v22.23.2 only via /opt/toolchains PATH; Chrome /usr/local/bin/chrome -> playwright chromium-1232, headless swiftshader ANGLE. Added scripts/measure-viewports.mjs (sibling of measure-load.mjs; measure-load.mjs NOT modified). NOTABLE DEVIATION FROM BRIEFING EXPECTATION: no route has a document-level horizontal scrollbar at 390x844 OR 1280x900 -- scrollWidth == innerWidth on all 5 routes at both widths (390/390 and 1280/1280), so the strict scrollWidth<=innerWidth assertion already passes on BEFORE. The real 390px issue is layout CRAMPING (stage/canvas vs control panel sharing the small viewport), visible in the before-*-390.png full-page shots, not overflow. FEAT-002/003 should preserve no-horizontal-scroll while relieving cramping. A11y state (verified in code): chef/coach/pet widgets have sr-only labels + focus rings + aria-live logs (role=log/progressbar); WardrobeBuilder.tsx has a role=radiogroup but NO sr-only label and NO aria-live (0 matches). Canvas ARIA: ChefScene role='img' aria-label='3D chef avatar' (L743-744), CoachScene '3D coach avatar' (L576-577), PetScene '3D virtual pet dog' (L585-586); WardrobeScene <Canvas> (L725) has NEITHER role NOR aria-label -- the one gap. Reduced motion: ZERO prefers-reduced-motion and ZERO window.matchMedia anywhere, so camera nudges, idle/ambient particle motion, wardrobe autoRotate (WardrobeScene L721/817-818, autoRotateSpeed 0.6), and landing CSS animations (animate-scan/emberPulse/ticker/marquee/ringSpin in app/page.tsx + animate-floatY in tailwind.config.ts) all run unconditionally. Evidence: 25 files under docs/a11y/ (before-{landing,chef,coach,wardrobe,pet}-{390,1280}.{png,json} + per-route summary .json) + BASELINE.md. Committed on branch; not pushed. node_modules/.next/out/assets-src are gitignored and NOT staged.
